title: Rusts rather quickly
text: Rusts rather quickly. I used this for less than two months before it started rusting. I was using it as a bird bath filled with water, changing the water every day and washing it with dish soap every other day and using a plastic bristle brush to clean it. Today I went to rinse and fill and found brown rusty water inside. Bummer.
